projectMove.body: The new weekly bug and exploit sweep makes its first pass this Tuesday around 10 AM, with Ram and Miyuki checking every site for booking-system weak spots, exposed private information, and broken links. ottoman.summary: After the war, Article 22 of the League of Nations Covenant placed former Ottoman lands under mandates, and the April 1920 San Remo conference handed Syria and Lebanon to France and Mesopotamia and Palestine to Britain. French forces crushed Faisal's Arab government in Damascus at Maysalun in July 1920, and Britain then made Faisal king of Iraq in 1921 after a costly revolt. Promised tutelage toward self-government meant outside control in practice, and these new borders were contested from the very start.

surprise.title: The day a Parisian cat went to space
surprise.body: On October 18, 1963, a Paris street cat later known as Félicette rode a French Véronique rocket to become the first cat ever launched into space. She was one of 14 cats trained for the program, wore sensors that tracked her brain activity the whole way up, and her capsule was recovered just 13 minutes after liftoff. Four years later on this exact date, in 1967, the Soviet probe Venera 4 became the first spacecraft to directly measure the atmosphere of another planet, Venus. October 18 has quietly been a big day for space.
